title: Tianji Resonance
next_chapter_hook: That transcendent consciousness quietly awaited Chen Ji's response, as if it had witnessed countless seers' choices since ancient times, and this time, its patience seemed exceptionally long.

text.content: The moment his fingertip touched the faint light of the Turtle Shell, Chen Ji's blood throughout his body seemed to ignite, boiling heat flowing along his meridians upward, rushing straight to his Brow Center. It was a scalding sensation he had never experienced before, yet not pain—but rather the roar of some ancient power awakining deep within his bloodline. The patterns on the Turtle Shell's surface suddenly blazed with golden-red light, like a divine beast that had slumbered for a thousand years opening its sleeping eyes.

dialogue.content: "Step back!" Mr. Mo's voice no longer held its usual composure but carried unprecedented panic. "That is no ordinary Turtle Shell—it is the burial place of generations of seers!"

text.content: Chen Ji tried to pull his hand back, but his fingertip seemed welded to the Turtle Shell by that golden-red light, utterly immovable. Immediately, a torrent of information surged into his consciousness like a breached dam—countless images, countless texts, countless intertwined causes and effects forming a massive dataset. His fontanelle felt as if struck by an invisible giant hammer, causing him to stumble backward, his spine slamming hard against the stone wall behind him.

"Chen Ji!" Mr. Mo's remnant soul flickered violently on the first page of the Tianji Record, his face—always calm—showing anxiety for the first time. "Your bloodline has resonated with this Turtle Shell; this is no coincidence—the blood flowing in you is that of generations of Tianji Record inheritors!"

Chen Ji knelt on one knee, his hands tightly gripping his temples. The madly pouring information exploded in his Mental Sea, every rune and every image tearing at his consciousness. The golden-red light on the Turtle Shell not only didn't weaken but grew even brighter, as if responding to some ancient summoning. Within the light, tiny lines of text began to appear, crawling across the entire shell surface like ants, densely packed.

Chen Ji had never studied those characters, yet he could understand every one—they were not written in language but directly branded truths onto the soul. The first line slowly emerged: "Those who peer into Heavenly Secrets shall invert Heaven's decree, receiving Heaven's calamities on its behalf, trading life for life." Chen Ji's heart sank heavily. This line's weight far exceeded his previous estimate. The price of the Tianji Record was far heavier than he had imagined.

Just then, something stirred deep within Chen Ji's Mental Sea. He sensed an unprecedented presence—not Mr. Mo's remnant soul, but something far more ancient, vast, and transcendent. It simply floated there at the edge of his consciousness, as the heavens gaze down upon ants, indifferent yet majestic, cold yet eternal.

dialogue.content: A genderless voice sounded in Chen Ji's consciousness, without temperature, without emotion, yet every word was clear: "The ninety-seventh generation... inheritor of the Tianji Record... has finally arrived."

text.content: Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. The ninety-seventh generation. This meant before him, at least ninety-six others had walked this far—and then what? Successful inheritance, or becoming part of the "burial place" as Mr. Mo had described? The cold sweat on his back instantly soaked through his clothes. That transcendent presence's gaze made him feel like a specimen placed on a surgical table.

Mr. Mo's remnant soul flickered frantically on the first page of the Tianji Record, trying to convey information but almost completely silenced by that transcendent consciousness's suppression. Chen Ji could only sense a few scattered words—"careful," "price," "choice"—faint as candles in the wind. The text on the Turtle Shell continued appearing, densely packed threads of cause and effect beginning to weave a massive web in Chen Ji's Mental Sea.

choice.prompt: Faced with that transcendent presence's gaze and the ceaseless influx of information, Chen Ji had to make a choice.

choices.description: Since the bloodline has already resonated, rather than passively enduring it, actively accepting this power might allow him to gain more information from it.
choices.visible_reward: Opportunity to Glimpse the Complete Truth of the Tianji Record
choices.risk_hint: The Intentions of That Presence Remain Unclear
choices.process_label: 陈机主动放开神识屏蔽

dialogue.content: That transcendent consciousness seemed rather satisfied with Chen Ji's initiative. The massive information torrent instantly flooded his Mental Sea like a tide. In an instant, Chen Ji "saw"—countless seers' faces flashed before him, some heroic, some unwilling, some resigned, all ultimately becoming incomplete records on the pages of the Tianji Record. And deep within those endless visions, a pair of golden eyes gazed quietly at him.

choices.description: Mr. Mo's warning was by no means unfounded. Rashly accepting gifts from unknown entities is foolish.
choices.visible_cost: May Be Judged Unworthy of Inheritance
choices.visible_reward: Maintain Clear Judgment of the Situation
choices.process_label: 陈机用意志力封锁识海

text.content: Chen Ji gritted his teeth, converging all his spiritual power into an iron wall, fiercely sealing off his Mental Sea. The information torrent collided with this barrier, producing thunderous clanging of metal. That transcendent consciousness seemed slightly startled, then emitted an extremely faint sneer: "Interesting... but can you hold on?" Before the words finished, an even more terrifying pressure descended.

Those golden eyes' gaze made Chen Ji's soul tremble. This was not any pressure a cultivator could possess—it was—Heaven itself? No, more concrete than Heaven, more... deliberate. Behind this consciousness stood not the abstract will of Heaven, but some entity with will, with purpose, that viewed all generations of seers as mere chess pieces.

Countless thoughts flashed through Chen Ji's mind like lightning. Mr. Mo had said the Tianji Record was a legacy left by generations of inheritors risking their lives. And this one before him was clearly no benevolent benefactor. It was waiting—for another controllable chess piece. And he, Chen Ji, stood at this moment right in the center of the chessboard.

dialogue.content: "Your bloodline is pure, your will is strong, your character... is also respectable." That voice spoke again, carrying the demeanor of one looking down from above. "Among the ninety-seven generations of inheritors, those who could maintain clarity before me number no more than three. You... are very interesting."

text.content: Interesting? Chen Ji coldly laughed in his heart. This evaluation was exactly like a merchant at a market selecting livestock, calculating his value. But he didn't speak, only accepting every piece of information transmitted by that transcendent consciousness一丝不苟地全部接收, even though each piece of information scorched his nerves like a branding iron. He was waiting—for this presence to reveal more of its cards.

The text on the Turtle Shell had already appeared for the most part. Chen Ji saw more truth about the Tianji Record. So it turned out that the so-called ability to "foresee three hours ahead" was merely a small sweet treat bestowed by the Eye of Heavenly Secrets upon its chess pieces. The true Tianji Record contained the power to rewrite causality, reverse life and death, even reshape heaven and earth—and the price for all these powers was the complete fortune and life of every inheritor through the ages.

choice.prompt: The truth of the Tianji Record was crueler than imagined, but with power right before his eyes, how should Chen Ji choose?

choices.description: Since he had already come this far, retreat would only undo all previous effort. Moreover, with his intellect, he might not be unable to seize the initiative back from the chess player.
choices.visible_cost: Become Completely a Chess Piece of the Eye of Heavenly Secrets
choices.visible_reward: Gain the Complete Power of the Tianji Record
choices.risk_hint: Once Accepted, There Will Be No Way Back

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath and made his decision. He proactively released the barrier around his consciousness, allowing that transcendent consciousness's massive information torrent to pour into his Mental Sea. In an instant, all the mysteries of the Tianji Record unfolded before him like a lifted veil—those incomplete pages were filling in one by one, and his Heavenly Fate Value was rapidly depleting at a visible rate.

choices.description: Never pay without compensation. Even if the other party is a transcendent entity, Chen Ji must fight for the greatest benefits and guarantees for himself.
choices.visible_cost: May Anger the Eye of Heavenly Secrets
choices.visible_reward: Perhaps Can Secure an Unequal Contract Clause
choices.risk_hint: Bargaining with Heaven is No Different from Making Deals with a Tiger

dialogue.content: "Before I accept," Chen Ji's voice echoed in his Mental Sea, calm as if he were not in dialogue with Heaven, "I need to know—what are the contract terms? What do you need me to do? What can I gain?" He did not shout, did not show fear, only a negotiating posture so calm it was近乎冷酷.

flags_set: 开始了与天道之眼的谈判

choices.description: This is clearly a trap! The price of the Tianji Record far exceeds his estimate. Accepting the inheritance would be like drinking poison to quench thirst.
choices.visible_cost: Lose This Opportunity to Grow Stronger
choices.risk_hint: May Forever Lose the Tianji Record
choices.process_label: 陈机准备强行切断联系

text.content: Chen Ji's eyes snapped open, a cold smile curling at the corner of his mouth. "Thank you for your kindness, but this inheritance—I, Chen Ji, do not covet it." Before the words finished, he began forcibly severing his connection with the Turtle Shell. However, that transcendent consciousness merely emitted a meaningful light laugh: "Refuse? You think having come this far, there is still a way back?"

Those golden eyes seemed to be examining every inch of Chen Ji's soul. After a moment, they emitted a faint sigh—that of a supreme being pitying an ant's struggles, yet carrying genuine appreciation. "Interesting... among the ninety-seven generations of inheritors, you are the first to dare negotiate terms with me."

Chen Ji did not speak, only quietly waiting. He knew too well the nature of negotiation—when the other party was willing to speak, it meant there was room for a deal. What he needed to do was, within the framework the other party set, fight for the greatest leverage for himself. The text on the Turtle Shell continued slowly appearing, but the speed had slowed, as if that presence was also considering how to respond to this inheritor who did not play by the rules.

Just then, Chen Ji suddenly felt a faint fluctuation from the first page of the Tianji Record—that was Mr. Mo's remnant soul straining to convey information. Though almost completely silenced by the suppression, Chen Ji still caught a few keywords from those断续的波动: "Careful... conditions... trap... it needs... your willingness..."

Chen Ji's heart sank heavily. "Willingness." These two words exploded in his mind like thunder. So that was it—the Eye of Heavenly Secrets did not need forcibly subjugated puppets, but chess pieces who willingly offered everything. The effect of forcibly obtained inheritance would be greatly reduced; only those who accepted willingly could truly unleash the full power of the Tianji Record. This was a trap, but also an opportunity.

In the Mental Sea, that transcendent presence spoke again, its voice carrying an undetectable hint of urgency: "You already know the price of the Tianji Record—foreseeing the future requires consuming Heavenly Fate Value, and the day your Heavenly Fate Value is exhausted is the day of your death. This is Heaven's law and cannot be changed. But..." it paused, "by becoming my inheritor, you will gain power beyond the mortal realm, enough to overthrow any enemy in this chaotic world."

dialogue.content: "Now, tell me your answer—" those golden eyes suddenly blazed with brilliant light, "Are you willing to bear the price of the Tianji Record?"

text.content: The text on the Turtle Shell was fully revealed. The final line was branded deep within Chen Ji's soul: "Those who accept the inheritance shall inherit the unfulfilled wishes of all previous Tianji Record inheritors, trading Heavenly Fate as the price to gain the ability to peer into Heavenly Secrets. Yet Heaven is utterly just; for every gain there must be a loss—Do you swear to this?"
